explanation: Place one queen per row. Check its column and both diagonals against every earlier queen, recurse only for valid placements, and copy complete column sequences.
timeComplexity: O(n²·n!) conservative worst-case search bound plus output
spaceComplexity: O(n) working space plus O(nS) output for S solutions
